declared_limits: All prices, speeds, rewards, arrivals, retention and operating cash are fictional and fixed before results.
Physical compatibility, READY attestations and quorum availability are modeled inputs, not cryptographic proofs.
Demand is sampled at individual request timestamps; leases last 900 seconds and receipts remain pending for the full configured delay.
No market equilibrium, human retention prediction, taxation, real electricity cost or proof of independent operators.
Commercial opportunity cost is a synthetic resource withdrawal with a separate cash counter; no x402 adapter or real settlement is tested.
An unsupported newly requested model remains unavailable; registration alone never manufactures a compatible route.
Precommitment is local and hash-verifiable, not an independent public timestamp or blinded third-party evaluation.
